meta.title: HSP Test - Are You a Highly Sensitive Person? Free
meta.description: Take the free HSP test to find out if you are a highly sensitive person. Answer 20 questions across 5 senses and get your sensitivity profile instantly.

app.title: HSP Test
app.subtitle: Sensory Overload Simulator
app.heroTitle: How Much Can Your Senses Handle?
app.heroDesc: Push through 5 sensory categories with escalating intensity. Tap out when you hit your limit — your threshold reveals your type.
app.disclaimer: For entertainment only. Not a clinical diagnosis.

l1.title: Café Ambience
l1.desc: Soft background music and gentle chatter in a cozy café.

l2.title: Busy Office
l2.desc: Multiple phone calls, keyboard clicking, and coworkers talking all at once around you.

l3.title: Construction Zone
l3.desc: Drilling, hammering, and heavy machinery operating right outside your window.

l4.title: Packed Concert
l4.desc: Bass shaking the floor, screaming crowd, speakers at max volume — pure sensory overload.

l1.title: Natural Sunlight
l1.desc: Working by a window with warm natural daylight streaming in.

l2.title: Fluorescent Office
l2.desc: Bright overhead fluorescent lights buzzing in a white-walled open office.

l3.title: Neon City Night
l3.desc: Walking through Times Square — flashing neon signs, moving billboards everywhere.

l4.title: Strobe Lights
l4.desc: Rapid strobes, laser beams, and intense projections at a packed nightclub.

l1.title: Soft Cotton
l1.desc: Wearing your favorite well-worn cotton T-shirt — perfectly broken in.

l2.title: Scratchy Tag
l2.desc: A brand new shirt with a stiff tag rubbing the back of your neck constantly.

l3.title: Wool on Skin
l3.desc: A chunky wool sweater directly on your bare skin on a warm day.

l4.title: Sensory Overload
l4.desc: Sand in your shoes, sticky sunscreen, saltwater drying on your face, wind whipping hair.

l1.title: Movie Farewell
l1.desc: A bittersweet goodbye scene in a movie — characters part ways with a smile.

l2.title: Friend's Bad Day
l2.desc: Your close friend calls with a breaking voice, telling you about their terrible day.

l3.title: Stranger's Tears
l3.desc: A stranger sitting alone on a park bench, crying quietly. No one stops to help.

l4.title: Heartbreak Story
l4.desc: Reading about families torn apart by disaster — children calling out for their parents.

l1.title: Coffee with Friend
l1.desc: A relaxed one-on-one coffee chat with your closest friend.

l2.title: Dinner Party
l2.desc: Dinner with 8 acquaintances. Small talk expected, you barely know half of them.

l3.title: Networking Event
l3.desc: A professional mixer with 40+ strangers, everyone exchanging business cards.

l4.title: Center Stage
l4.desc: Giving a speech to 200+ people. All eyes on you, cameras recording everything.

rock.name: 🪨 Rock Solid
rock.desc: Barely anything rattles you! You have a remarkably resilient nervous system that thrives under stimulation.
tips: Try mindfulness to tune into subtleties

breeze.name: 🌿 Gentle Breeze
breeze.desc: You balance resilience and awareness beautifully. You notice the details without getting overwhelmed.
tips: Use your awareness as a social superpower

wave.name: 🌊 Flowing Wave
wave.desc: Your sensitivity is your superpower! You read rooms, feel music deeply, and connect with others on a profound level.

butterfly.name: 🦋 Delicate Butterfly
butterfly.desc: You experience the world in 4K! Your finely tuned senses detect what others miss — this is a gift, not a flaw.

antenna.name: 🧠 Ultra Antenna
antenna.desc: You're a true HSP — picking up every signal. Your brain processes ALL stimuli deeply, giving you extraordinary perception.
